objections.challenge: True hidden contingency/switching process could be represented as the learner's internal state.
objections.finding: Source distinguishes external latent generative state from posterior mean/variance and inferred volatility maintained by the learner.

objections.challenge: Softmax response rule could be mistaken for the learning operator.
objections.finding: Source feeds VKF predictions/action values into a separate softmax choice mapping; softmax beta is response noise.

objections.challenge: Volatility-dependent learning rate could be redescribed as a separate controller.
objections.finding: It arises within source VKF inference/update; no separate control module is specified.

objections.challenge: Latent-space learning rate and implied observation-space learning rate could be collapsed.
objections.finding: Source explicitly shows they differ; observation-space implied rate can change even when volatility is fixed.

objections.test: inference-only parameter mistaken for world state
objections.challenge: Binary noise parameter omega could be treated as a generative environmental variable.
objections.finding: Source states omega is relevant only to the inference model, not the generative process.

objections.test: externally imposed switching schedule mistaken for model dynamics
objections.challenge: Simulation change-points could be read as endogenous VKF state transitions.
objections.finding: Source notes some switching dynamics do not match its Gaussian-random-walk assumptions; schedule remains external.

objections.test: inherited machinery mistaken for new contribution
objections.challenge: Kalman/HGF/Bayesian machinery could be counted as de novo architecture.
objections.finding: Source positions VKF relative to Kalman, Behrens/HGF and approximate Bayesian inference; inherited basis is retained.

objections.challenge: Parameter recovery might be summarized as uniformly strong.
objections.finding: Source reports volatility update rate and initial volatility are more prone to recovery error.

source_ordered_omission_sweep.result: external latent state and learner posterior state separated.
error-correction and fixed-volatility special case retained.
moment matching and inference-only omega retained.
softmax readout and parameter-recovery limits retained.
generative mismatch and mechanistic/approximation limits retained.
